mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases by >0.5% in a month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals increased demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by >2% in a month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a slowdown in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases by >1% in a month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is high and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase, it signals a recovery in the labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 6% and PAYEMS increases by >0.5% in a month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is low and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases, it signals inflationary pressure that the Fed may address with rate hikes, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL increases by >0.5% in a month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases by >1% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 decreases by >0.5% in a quarter
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.
